# QR Code generator

`qrcodegen.c` and `qrcodegen.h` are the unmodified C implementation from
[Nayuki QR-Code-generator v1.8.0](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/c).
They are licensed under MIT; the complete license is retained in both headers.
MeshMatsu generates standard channel invitation URLs with medium error correction,
automatic version/mask selection and a four-module quiet border.
